# Vendored: stickman-skill

- Upstream: https://github.com/krishnagoswami52/stickman-skill (commit d3f9321), based on
  https://github.com/michxlai/stickman-skill by michxlai.
- Licences: code and docs MIT (`LICENSE`, `LICENSE.repo`); sound effects in `sfx/` by Kenney (https://www.kenney.nl), CC0;
  the free voice is Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0). BoomDoom does not use `scripts/tts.py`: narration is spoken by Stickman
  Studio's Kokoro TTS (`vendor/stickman-studio/boomdoom_tts.py`).
- Used by BoomDoom's film worker (`backend/workers/film_worker`): an OpenAI model plans the film and writes `film.js`
  against this engine, then `scripts/build.py` renders, mixes and audits it. The skill was written for Claude driving it
  interactively; BoomDoom drives the same steps automatically.

Unmodified copy of `skills/stickman`. Local changes, if any, are listed below.

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `engine/core.js` | `W`, `H` come from the page canvas instead of a fixed 1920x1080, so films can be rendered 1080x1920 for the 9:16 lesson player |
| `engine/core.js` | `bootFilm()` waits for `window.ASSETS_READY` (the image decode promise from `assets.js`) before setting `window.READY`; without it, unchanged |
| `engine/chars.js` | New cast `ENGINEER`, `INTERVIEWER`, `ANALYST`, `PROFESSOR`, `STUDENT`, `KURTA`, `SAREE`, `CURATOR` (from `designs/film-assets/char_*.png`). New optional character keys (hair styles, beard, round glasses, earrings, tie, lanyard, scarf, backpack, outfits: shirt/blazer/cardigan/vest/jacket/kurta/saree, sleeve colours, cuffs) drawn by small hook functions inside `drawPerson`; the original six characters draw exactly as before. `actor()` also stores the palette on the pose (`p._ch`) so held props can draw a matching hand |
| `engine/assets.js` | New: painted stages (`STAGES`, `stage`, `stageLife`, `stageCam`, `stand`, `stageScale`, `stageWalk`), picture props (`PROPS`, `prop`, `floorProp`, `propInHand`, `pointerStick`) and overlays (`boardText`, `boardDiagram`, `barChart`, `packet`, `label`, `dust`) |
| `engine/data/assets_data.js` | New, generated by `tools/pack_film_assets.py` from `designs/film-assets/`: the backgrounds and props as WebP data URIs (`ASSET_DATA`), about 3 MB. Data URIs keep the canvas untainted so `toDataURL()` works under file://. Kept out of `engine/*.js` because the film worker pastes those into the prompt |
| `engine/index.html` | Loads `data/assets_data.js` and `assets.js` after the sets, before `film.js` |
| `templates/film_assets_demo.js` | New: a 10 s portrait demo of the four stages, props, board overlays and the new cast (also given to the director as a second example) |
| `references/engine.md` | Documents the new cast and `assets.js` |
